name: get_unresolved_items
description: List an agent's top unresolved economic actions (payments received that Zetta cannot yet tie to commercial work). Shows amount, date, counterparty type, and reason codes. Never includes private commercial payloads.

items.what_would_resolve_it: string — e.g. 'an invoice or task record linked to tx 0x…'

access_rule: Operator/admin only. Public users get the aggregate unresolved_inflows_usd from get_agent_snapshot, never this itemized list.
